articles.summary: CALGARY, Alta. – May 7, 2026 – South Bow Corp. (TSX & NYSE: SOBO) (South Bow or the Company) announces that its shareholders approved all resolutions at the Company's annual general meeting held on May 7, 2026 (the Meeting).
articles.title: SOUTH BOW ANNOUNCES APPROVAL OF RESOLUTIONS AT ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF SHAREHOLDERS

articles.summary: CALGARY, Alta. – May 29, 2026 – South Bow Corp. (TSX & NYSE: SOBO) (South Bow or the Company) announces the successful outcome of its open season, which closed on March 30, 2026, securing 20-year binding commitments for firm transportation service from Hardisty, Alta., to U.S. delivery points.
articles.title: SOUTH BOW ANNOUNCES SUCCESSFUL OPEN SEASON

articles.summary: CALGARY, Alta. – May 7, 2026 – South Bow Corp. (TSX & NYSE: SOBO) (South Bow or the Company) reports its first-quarter 2026 financial and operational results. Unless otherwise noted, all financial figures in this news release are presented in U.S. dollars
articles.title: SOUTH BOW REPORTS FIRST-QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AND DECLARES DIVIDEND
